hero.title: Graph-Powered Conversational AI
hero.subtitle: Design, visualize, and run complex AI workflows on an interactive canvas. Build branching conversations, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and interact through a polished chat experience.

problem.title: The Problem with Traditional AI Chat
problem.subtitle: Linear conversations limit what's possible

context.title: Lost Context
context.description: Important information gets buried in long chat histories

linear.title: Linear Thinking
linear.description: No way to branch, explore alternatives, or backtrack efficiently

opacity.title: Black Box Execution
opacity.description: You can't see how the AI is processing your requests

single.title: Single Model Lock-in
single.description: Stuck with one model's perspective and limitations

solution.title: Where Conversations Become Workflows
solution.description: Meridian transforms AI interactions from linear chats into visual, executable graphs. Each node represents a step in your workflow—context inputs, model calls, logic branches, or parallel processing. Build once, execute anywhere, and see exactly how your AI agents think.

visual.title: Think Visually
visual.description: Design workflows as connected nodes on an interactive canvas

orchestrate.title: Orchestrate Precisely
orchestrate.description: Run entire graphs or specific sub-sections with full visibility

branch.title: Branch Naturally
branch.description: Create complex decision trees and parallel reasoning paths

integrate.title: Integrate Deeply
integrate.description: Pull GitHub repos, files, and custom data as live context

features.title: Core Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to build sophisticated AI workflows

canvas.title: Visual Graph Canvas
canvas.description: Interactive workspace for building and managing AI workflows as interconnected nodes

nodes.title: Modular Node System
nodes.description: Input nodes (Prompt, Attachment, GitHub) and Generator nodes (Text-to-Text, Parallelization, Routing)

chat.title: Integrated Chat Interface
chat.description: Feature-rich chat view that mirrors and drives the graph execution in real-time

execution.title: Execution Engine
execution.description: Run entire graphs or sub-sections with visual execution plans and real-time status

models.title: Multi-Model Backend
models.description: Access 50+ models via OpenRouter.ai with granular parameter control

content.title: Rich Content Rendering
content.description: Full Markdown, LaTeX, syntax highlighting for 200+ languages, and Mermaid diagrams

github.title: GitHub Integration
github.description: Use entire repositories or specific files as context for code-aware assistance

auth.title: Enterprise Auth
auth.description: OAuth (GitHub, Google) and password authentication with JWT security

tracking.title: Cost Tracking
tracking.description: Monitor token usage and costs for every model call with full transparency
